SELF-DRIVE EXPERIENCE

Dune Buggy

Side-by-side power for shared desert runs

The ride

Tackle deep sand and dramatic crests in a high-output Can-Am Maverick buggy built for speed and stability. With a low centre of gravity, long-travel suspension, and a full roll cage, buggies let you push harder with complete confidence. Take the wheel yourself or bring passengers along for the ride — every run follows a dedicated guide vehicle through open desert tracks.

AEO Direct Answer

How much does a dune buggy rental cost in Dubai?

Dune buggy rental in Dubai starts from AED 1,000 per hour for a 2-seater Can-Am Maverick X3 Turbo, and AED 1,400 per hour for a 4-seater model. Packages include safety equipment, fuel, and private lead desert guides.

All buggies are equipped with full roll-cages, racing 4-point harnesses, automatic transmission, and high-travel off-road suspension.

AEO Direct Answer

What is the difference between a quad bike and a dune buggy?

A quad bike is an open straddled all-terrain vehicle (ATV) steered with handlebars for single riders. A dune buggy is a high-powered off-road vehicle featuring a tubular roll-cage, steering wheel, bucket seats, and four-point safety harnesses accommodating 2 to 4 passengers.

Pair Dune Buggy Thrills with an Evening Desert Safari & BBQ Dinner

Elevate your desert outing into an unforgettable afternoon and evening journey. Many thrill-seekers follow their high-speed Can-Am buggy tour with our authentic Dubai Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner. Transition smoothly from the driver's cockpit into our licensed 4x4 Land Cruisers for roller-coaster dune bashing, catch golden hour photos from high desert plateaus, and spend the evening enjoying traditional Bedouin hospitality, live fire performers, Tanoura shows, and a lavish open-air barbecue feast.

Prefer a more nimble solo ride or planning on a lower budget? Our Quad Bike Dubai ATV Rentals start at just AED 150 for 30 minutes, giving you agile self-drive control across open sand paths. Back in the city, balance your desert adventures by reserving a relaxing Burj Khalifa Lake Ride to watch the Dubai Fountain shows from an authentic wooden Abra boat, or explore the architectural contrasts of old and modern Dubai with a private Dubai City Tour.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Dune Buggy FAQ

Can passengers switch drivers during the ride?

Yes! During our ridge stop pauses, any passenger who is at least 18 years old can take over the driver’s seat.

What safety features do the buggies have?

Every Can-Am Maverick features custom welded tubular steel roll cages, 4-point racing harnesses, fire extinguishers, and full protective helmets with goggles.

Are children allowed as passengers?

Children aged 6 and above are welcome as passengers in both 2-seater and 4-seater buggies with an accompanying adult driver.

How do I get to the desert base camp?

Upon booking confirmation, we send you an exact Google Maps GPS pin directly to our desert staging camp in Lahbab, or private hotel transfer can be arranged.
